# Hush binding generator

# We must run hush-export.exe agains ./bindings.cpp with the -p flag that points to the compile_commands.json file generated by CMake.
# This will generate two files: HushBindings.h and HushBindings.cpp.

add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/HushBindings.hushgen.cpp
        COMMAND ${HUSH_EXPORT_BIN} -p ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bindings/bindings.cpp
        DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bindings/bindings.cpp
        COMMENT "Generating HushBindings.h and HushBindings.cpp using hush-export.exe"
)
